# North Carolina History

> > A comprehensive resource documenting North Carolina's historical regions, cultures, and communities from the Appalachian mountains to the coast.

North Carolina History provides in-depth exploration of the state's diverse regions, including the western mountain counties, Native American heritage of the Catawba Nation, and the cultural development of Appalachian communities. The site covers historical landmarks, regional cultures, and the people who shaped North Carolina's identity.

## Key Topics

- Catawba Indians
- Catawba Nation
- Appalachian mountains
- Western North Carolina
- Mountain counties (Buncombe, Madison, Yancey)
- Native American tribes
- Regional culture
- Historical landmarks
- University of North Carolina at Asheville
- Appalachian region
- Marshall
- Rock Hill, South Carolina
- Tennessee border region
- Mountain heritage

## Regional History

- [Mountains - North Carolina History](https://northcarolinahistory.org/region/mountains): Western NC mountain region history featuring Catawba Nation & Appalachia
